business_rules: Empty registry is a valid steady state, not an error.
Verdict is pass regardless of entry count.
behavior.summary: Read .harness/runtime/running_sensors.json (present, empty map). Fold zero entries into a pass Signal whose metadata.kind=list and metadata.entries=[].

description: Happy idle path: /list-sensors with no running sensors emits exactly one pass Signal whose metadata.kind=list and metadata.entries=[].

evidence.rationale: runList iterates over the entries map and emits the list Signal even when empty.

invariants: metadata.entries is an empty array (not null, not absent).
expected_outcome.summary: Stdout has exactly one Signal: verdict=pass metadata.kind=list metadata.entries=[].

name: List sensors when registry file is present but empty

trigger.summary: Agent invokes /list-sensors with no arguments after the registry file has been created but no sensors are live.
